summary: BitBucketClient (issue #345 Part 2) is fully implemented per the plan. New modules src/awf/common/bitbucket_client.py and bitbucket_client_parsing.py stay under the 1500-line guardrail and implement all 10 ForgeClient methods with the corrected BB Cloud REST v2.0 mappings (POST pullrequests; pipeline-lookup chain with singular /steps/{uuid}/log + Range tail; POST .../resolve never DELETE; full-pipeline rerun via reconstructed pipeline_pullrequest_target with conservative not-rerunnable fallback; create_issue 404 -> PR-comment fallback; merge_pr sending BB strategy values incl. first-class fast_forward; merge methods derived from PR destination.branch.merge_strategies). Locked decisions D1 (injected httpx.AsyncClient + from_env), D2 (shared _request with 429/Retry-After backoff, cursor pagination, bounded LRU ETag/If-None-Match cache keyed per (method,path,params), X-RateLimit-NearLimit slow-down), D5 (merge-method mapping), and D6 (explicit basic/bearer auth modes, BITBUCKET_AUTH_NOT_CONFIGURED, secret redaction via redact_secrets, never logging the Authorization header) are all honored. The gate is flipped (_SUPPORTED_FORGES adds bitbucket; make_forge_client('bitbucket') returns BitBucketClient.from_env; unknown forges still raise). The 4 planned reason codes are added to service/doctor/reasons.py and the regenerated docs/REASON_CATALOG.md, and FORGE_NOT_SUPPORTED text refreshed. Tests cover per-method happy/error/pagination/auth plus all special cases (429-then-success, 304 ETag hit + eviction, NearLimit, resolve POST, tracker-disabled comment fallback, rerun reconstruct + not-rerunnable, merge round-trip incl. fast_forward-only, pipeline-lookup chain + pytest fallback, redaction), a Protocol-conformance suite, and the gate-flip regressions across test_forge.py, test_executor_forge_gate.py, test_pr_monitor_adoption, test_executor_error_paths_part_015.py and worker. The #352 merge-gate seam was investigated and flagged (fast_forward-only BB repos conservatively block via NotifyHuman rather than mis-merge). The recovery_preserved_queries open-PR resolver was correctly kept GitHub-only so flipping the global gate does not mis-route BitBucket through gh pr list (out-of-scope per plan). ITERATION 1 closed the live-docs verification gate: the authoritative OpenAPI 2.0 spec at https://api.bitbucket.org/swagger.json was fetched and every endpoint/verb/field verified (9/10 mappings confirmed correct, incl. singular /log, POST=resolve/DELETE=reopen, merge_strategy enum, commit-status + PR-state enums). The gate caught one genuine bug: the rerun pipeline-trigger selector was {type: 'pull_requests'} (underscore) but the live docs require the hyphenated {type: 'pull-requests'}; fixed in bitbucket_client.py with a strengthened test assertion (test-first). Validation evidence in the VALIDATION doc reports focused pytest/ruff/mypy/catalog checks green with 100% focused coverage on the new modules; broad AWF/CI gates run post-agent.
gaps: Integration follow-ups (forge-neutral runner error handling, BB adoption metadata fetcher, PR creation/push, forge-neutral merge gate for fast_forward) are explicitly out of scope per the plan's no-touch list and flagged for Part 3. These do not affect the BitBucketClient deliverable itself.
